primary_view: Livelikerw 2014-01-27, EXIF upright 4912 × 3264; coordinates here are taken from a 760 × 505 resample of that image.

near_chamfer.ground_wall: 2016 detail archive-11 resolves three free brick shafts, Ionic capitals, curved stone fascia, repeating terracotta leaf-and-scroll ornaments and a curved brick parapet.

north_chamfer: Similar brick parapet and finials are visible in the 2016 northeast photo archive-06. The coarse city footprint includes the north diagonal. The south diagonal and reverse-view dimensions are an approximate reconstruction.
dimensions: Corner radius, return offsets, column dimensions, individual terracotta relief and the rear timber vestibule depth are inferred. Only the observed portion of the street frontage is represented.
rear_door_test: The partially shaded rear oak arch failed to yield a repeatable match in the two images. Recess depth 2.78 m is estimated from the three threshold steps and side views, separate from the measured +0.745 m front inscription and +0.69 m capital faces.
